## What changed

Describe the public behavior and why it changed.

## Verification

- [ ] I added or updated user-observable tests where relevant.
- [ ] I ran `yarn typecheck`, `yarn lint`, and the relevant tests.
- [ ] I ran `yarn docs:build` when documentation or public API changed.

## Release surface

- [ ] I added a Changeset for a user-visible package change, or this change does not affect the published package.
- [ ] I updated the canonical guides, generated API manifest, or type-checked teaching examples when their public contract changed.

Do not include maintainer-only triage instructions or unpublished compatibility promises in this public template.
